name: upgrade_pipes
summary: Swap normal pipe for insulated pipe in place (gas to insulated gas, liquid to insulated liquid), or burst pipe for new (to repair), keeping the network's contents whole. As upgrade_cables, with a gas check. Dry run by default; confirm to swap.

help.text: Each replacement joins the network before its old piece leaves, so the network's gas is never split, vented or divided; only its volume changes by the pieces' volume difference. Pieces already insulated and members that are not pipes (vents, drains, radiators) stay. to repair swaps each burst piece (not_burst keeps the others) for a new piece of its own kit, the same way, so a burst pipe that is the only pipe of its network keeps the contents. Kits instead of coils; refund gives back the normal kits.
help.keys: job_id, status, ready, problems [], pieces [], by_prefab [], kept_pieces [], swapped [], removed [], not_swapped [], refund [], preflight_summary, final_check, verification, gas_check, error.

report.summary: The pipe numbers in the report.
report.text: by_prefab adds max_pressure_kpa before and after (the same for normal and insulated), volume_l before and after, and heat_exchange_factor before and after (insulated pipe exchanges little or no heat). networks give content, total_mol, energy_j, temperature_k, volume_l and pressure_kpa before and after, and lowest_max_pressure_kpa_after. After a run the verification checks the same gas, the predicted volume and the same contents.

problems.text: As upgrade_cables, plus no_atmosphere, atmosphere_busy (a gas change, game event or queued move_gas touching the network waits for the next atmospherics tick: try again), content_mismatch, would_burst (the pressure after would pass the lowest pipe rating).

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: A network, every piece of it: its id or a handle on it (see networks).

reference_ids.description: Pieces by reference id, up to 4096; or give network_id.

to.description: insulated (default), or repair: burst pieces become new ones.

from_id.description: The thing whose slots pay and take the refund; default the player (see swaps/materials).

refund.description: Give back what deconstructing the old pieces would. Default true; false is refund_to none.

limit.description: Pieces listed per list; default 5. All are counted and checked.

job_id.description: Poll a confirmed run; give nothing else.
